caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically-oriented candlestick on a plain, light-colored background. The candlestick is rendered mainly in light pencil and subtle shades of blue, suggesting a glass or possibly metal material with reflective properties. The object features a round, flat top, a series of ridges and curves along a tall, tapering stem, and a broad, ornate base with multiple layered, undulating edges. The base is shown with detailed lines, emphasizing its symmetrical, decorative form. To the lower right of the candlestick, there is a geometric diagram drawn in fine lines, illustrating the base's outline and symmetry with intersecting curved patterns and axes centered at a single point. At the very bottom, a faint inscription reads: "Detail of base. Grooves go freely base to A."
title: Candlestick
